@Sofia, the last number posted in #coastal-team for Saltmarsh Provisions is **10%**. Bettina posted 12% on Nov 17, 2025, then retracted it a few minutes later and corrected it to 10%.

Her correction says she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark, so I wouldn't treat 10% as final until June confirms it. I couldn't find a signed order form or amendment in the files I can see. Before the renewal brief goes out, ask June, or check the executed contract.
